t1709:
An adventurer of Loki Familia.
She wears a Far Eastern furisode, a gift from Loki.
For the Guild's "New Year's Lucky Girl Pageant," she wears a restraint cast under the kimono to hold back her overwhelming Level 6 strength—yet even restrained, her first-tier power leaves everyone else in the dust.
t1710:
An adventurer of Hestia Familia.
Forced by circumstances to earn a million valis, she swallowed her pride and donned a bunny girl outfit.
While diligently carrying out her new duties as a bunny girl, she strikes down the evil lurking in the holy night's shadows as the Bunny Samurai of Justice.
t1711:
A cat person waitress at the Orario tavern The Benevolent Mistress.
This summer she's going wild in her swimsuit! "Everyone bow down to Myaa's swimsuit, meow!"
She's playing around even more freely than usual.
t1712:
A boy who came to Orario dreaming of becoming an adventurer.
Still a Level 1 rookie, he often finds himself in a pinch in the Dungeon.
No one wants to grow stronger more than he does—and that very desire drives his explosive growth.
t1713:
An adventurer of Hestia Familia.
He wears the battle cloth Welf made for him.
Curious about Ais's... date? with Mord, he ends up tagging along with Lefiya.
t1714:
An adventurer of Hestia Familia.
Without telling anyone, he joins Demeter's cooking class and ends up making chocolate with Ryu and Eina, who are there too. Truth is, he isn't fond of sweets.
t1715:
An adventurer of Hestia Familia.
He wears a borrowed formal suit for the ball, and wears it well.
At the Gods' Banquet, everyone helped Bell dance with Ais. This time, he heads to the ball to support Chigusa.
t1716:
An adventurer of Hestia Familia.
He wears mining clothes he got from Hermes.
Wanting to help Lili in her fight to fix the Familia's finances, he swings a pickaxe in a mine where a giant gold nugget lies sleeping.
t1717:
An adventurer of Hestia Familia.
He wears battle cloth that Harmonia bought him so he'd be properly dressed to walk the streets with a great actress.
His gallant, valiant look somehow calls to mind a hero of old.
t1718:
An adventurer of Hestia Familia.
Thanks to a rare skill, he has grown at a staggering pace. With the fastest Level Up in history and one irregular after another overcome, he is the talk of Orario: [Little Rookie].
t1719:
A smith who later converts to Hestia Familia to help Bell in a crisis.
He still hates magic swords, but he's grown flexible enough to forge them when the situation calls for it, for Bell and the Familia's sake.
t1720:
A smith with a skill that lets him forge powerful magic swords.
A good-natured young man, he's Bell's friend and his personal smith.
He's a skilled smith; his only flaw is his tragic sense for names.
t1721:
An adventurer of Hestia Familia.
Wearing mining clothes Hermes prepared, he aims to dig up the giant gold nugget.
In the mining town of Golden he takes pickaxe repairs on the side, and the miners have come to rely on him.
t1722:
An adventurer of Loki Familia.
She achieved the great feat of slaying the 37th-floor floor boss alone and leveled up to Level 6.
Curious about Bell's abnormal growth rate, she often offers him her help.
t1723:
An adventurer of Loki Familia.
She is hailed as one of the strongest women active in the Dungeon.
Many admire her breathtaking beauty, Bell among them. A natural airhead.
t1724:
An adventurer of Loki Familia.
She wears a fresh, healthy-looking swimsuit.
She can't swim, so she never lets go of her float ring.
t1725:
An adventurer of Loki Familia.
At Finn's suggestion, she wears an adorable pure-white outfit.
During the Snow Competition, her catchphrase is "Sir, Yes Sir, Oh Yeah."
t1726:
An adventurer who later converts to Hestia Familia to repay her debt to Bell and save him in a crisis.
She has a cute, quirky side: she loves hot springs so much she has her own bathing etiquette.
t1727:
An adventurer who studies under the god Takemikazuchi, master of every martial art.
From the Far East, she grew up with Chigusa, Ouka, and Haruhime.
She secretly harbors feelings for Takemikazuchi, who raised her.
t1728:
An adventurer of Hestia Familia.
She wears a swimsuit that's Far Eastern through and through.
She seems torn over whether to show it to Takemikazuchi.
t1729:
A cat person waitress at the Orario tavern The Benevolent Mistress.
A self-admitted lover of young boys, she has a particular weakness for Bell's perky behind.
She often hangs out with her fellow waitress Anya.
t1730:
A human waitress at the Orario tavern The Benevolent Mistress.
At the tavern she often ends up as the straight man to Anya and Chloe.
With her monstrous strength, she once made a name for herself as a bounty hunter called [Black Fist].
t1731:
A cat person waitress at the Orario tavern The Benevolent Mistress.
A bright, energetic airhead.
Along with her partner Chloe, she's a troublemaking kitty who slacks off work and often pulls silly stunts.
t1732:
A kindhearted elven mage. With magic-focused abilities, skills, and even extremely rare magic, her potential is immeasurable.
She adores Ais single-mindedly, and is often overly conscious of Bell.
t1733:
One of Loki Familia's first-tier adventurers.
She's in love with Finn and acts demure around him, but she shows no mercy to any woman who tries to get close to him.
t1734:
An Amazon, the elder of the Hyrute sisters, and a core adventurer of Loki Familia.
Normally calm and ladylike, but once she snaps, she becomes a berserker no one can stop.
t1735:
An adventurer of Loki Familia.
When she put on a pure-white dress left behind by "the most vicious Familia in history," she was supposedly possessed by the lingering thoughts within it... yet her single-minded love for Finn makes her look much the same as usual.
t1736:
One of Loki Familia's first-tier adventurers.
Ever since she saw Bell fight the Minotaur, she has seen in him the hero of a tale she loved as a child, and she fondly calls him [Argonaut].
t1737:
An Amazon, the younger of the Hyrute sisters, and a core adventurer of Loki Familia.
A carefree mood maker and a good friend to Ais.
For an Amazon, she's self-conscious about her flat figure.
t1738:
One of Loki Familia's first-tier adventurers.
Crude and often abusive, he's feared by those around him.
But his words don't seem meant simply to mock—they seem rooted in his past experiences.
t1739:
A werewolf adventurer at the core of Loki Familia.
Belligerent by nature, he throws harsh words at the weak.
He wraps magic around his metal boots [Frosvirt] and slaughters enemies with fierce kicks.
t1740:
One of the oldest executives supporting Loki Familia.
Not just boisterous, he's a powerhouse with a calm, thoughtful side.
He looks after others well, and is as happy to see the Familia's younger generation grow as if it were his own success.
t1741:
A dwarf first-tier adventurer worthy of the word "hero."
He received his Falna around the same time as Finn and Riveria and has supported Loki Familia ever since.
No one in Orario can match the toughness of his body.
t1742:
An adventurer of Loki Familia.
At Finn's suggestion, he wears a bright-red outfit.
Anyone who sees him laughing heartily can't help but smile too.
t1743:
A waitress at the tavern The Benevolent Mistress and a former adventurer.
Invited by the god Hermes, she came to Lake Lolog on vacation and changed into a swimsuit—only to end up as the detective and take an active(?) role as the Swimsuit Detective of Justice.
t1744:
An adventurer of Astraea Familia.
To help Bell and the others in the Familia War against Freya Familia, she visited the Sword-Forge City of Solingen, where her patron goddess Astraea was staying, and reached Level 6 through grueling training.
Having inherited the "justice" of Alise and the others, Ryu inherits their strength too and charges down the path she believes in.
t1745:
A [Magic Swordsman] who fights with Concurrent Chanting magic and swordplay. She reveres her patron god Dionysus.
A survivor of the tragedy known as the "27th-Floor Nightmare," she avoided others because of it, but since meeting Lefiya and getting to know her, her attitude has slowly begun to change.
t1746:
An adventurer of Dian Cecht Familia.
She bears the title [Dea Saint] and is renowned as the finest healer in the city.
She often deals with the members of Loki Familia and is on close terms with Ais and the others.
t1747:
A follower of Aphrodite Familia.
As egotistical as her patron goddess, she stirs up trouble at every turn, yet she's a first-rate actress who takes the stage with a firm "philosophy."
Audiences who see her brilliant acting are captivated, every one of them.
t1748:
The leader of sorts of the Xenos, with combat power on par with a first-tier adventurer. Adventurers whisper rumors of him as an armored monster.
Friendly by nature, he nicknames Bell "Bellcchi" and eagerly chats with Bell and the others who came to visit.
t1749:
A first-tier adventurer of Freya Familia. The vice-captain, said to have the fastest legs of any adventurer, he holds the title "Fastest in the City."
Always intimidating and unapproachable. His spearmanship with his silver spear is every bit a match for Ais.
t1750:
A first-tier adventurer of Freya Familia. One of quadruplets, whose teamwork gives them the strength of a Lv. 6.
As the eldest who keeps his brothers in line, he's usually calm and sensible, but he's said to be the most troublesome when angered. Incidentally, their title refers to all four of them together.
t1751:
A first-tier adventurer of Freya Familia.
The most vicious magic swordsman, bearing the title [Dainsleif]... except he's extremely timid and shy. Perhaps to hide that, he tends to act in ways the gods tease as "chuunibyou."
But once he uses his personality-altering magic [Dainsleif], Hogni becomes a true "King of Dark Battle," crushing every foe with overwhelming close combat.
t1752:
Patron goddess of Artemis Familia, which operates outside Orario. One of the three great virgin goddesses.
She demanded an almost absurd strictness in matters of romance,
but on reuniting with Hestia, Artemis was as innocent as a young girl.
t1753:
One who was—once—the patron goddess of Artemis Familia.
To atone for the "great sin" she once committed, which could destroy the mortal world, she sets out with Hermes to slay "Antares."
And then she meets Bell Cranel, the one chosen by Orion's Arrow—
t1754:
A waitress at the tavern The Benevolent Mistress and a former adventurer.
Having accepted Bell as her coworker Syr's future partner, she looks out for him and lends him a hand.
She was formidable in her adventuring days and still has superb combat skills.
t1755:
An elf who works at The Benevolent Mistress.
When she first started, she was a hopeless employee who couldn't even peel a vegetable properly, but now she manages to do her job.
With her strong sense of responsibility, she handles the tavern's grueling day-to-day work.
t1756:
An elf who works at The Benevolent Mistress.
She came to Pumpkin Village to look into something.
For the village festival, she's dressed in a witch costume matching Syr's.
t1757:
An elf who works at The Benevolent Mistress.
To help her best friend Syr make chocolate, she joins Demeter's cooking class, where women gather.
There she meets Bell, and frets over just who he's going to give chocolate to.
t1758:
An elf who works at The Benevolent Mistress.
When she put on a pure-white dress left behind by "the most vicious Familia in history," some curse turned her into a blade that judges unfaithful men.
No leniency for cheaters. Those who stray will be punished with the full might of an upper-class adventurer.
t1759:
One of Loki Familia's first-tier adventurers.
A high-spirited adventurer who charges ahead with a smile no matter what.
This time, through a certain turn of events, she takes on the role of the "magical girl" Sunny Smile and fights for a young girl's smile.
t1760:
An adventurer of Hermes Familia.
Highly capable as an adventurer, she's also skilled across the board, from commanding as captain to crafting magic items with her rare ability [Mystery]. Many besides her patron god Hermes rely on her.
t1761:
The captain of Freya Familia.
The only Level 7 in Orario, he is the city's strongest in both name and fact.
He has sworn absolute loyalty to Freya and shows no mercy to anyone who insults her.
t1762:
The captain of Freya Familia.
The city's strongest adventurer at Level 7, yet his life has been a string of "defeats," mired in dirt, mud, blood, and humiliation.
And that is exactly why he never forgives his own weakness, training with resolve to climb higher, still growing even now in pursuit of true "strength."
t1763:
An adventurer who converted to Miach Familia after losing the War Game.
A veteran among third-tier adventurers with a gift for command.
She's often found with Cassandra.
t1764:
An adventurer of Miach Familia.
She came to Pumpkin Village in search of pumpkeens, an ingredient for medicine.
For the village festival, she's dressed as a vampire, drawing in everyone who sees her.
t1765:
A healer who converted to Miach Familia after losing the War Game.
Extremely shy, she looks up to Daphne, her complete opposite.
She has strange prophetic dreams, but hardly anyone believes her.
t1766:
An adventurer of Miach Familia.
She came to Pumpkin Village in search of pumpkeens, an ingredient for medicine.
For the village festival,
she's dressed in an adorable mummy costume.
t1767:
A battle prostitute (berbera) of Ishtar Familia.
Bold and free-spirited, but a big-sister type who looks after others and is widely trusted, she's effectively the vice-captain.
She also dotes on Haruhime like a little sister.
t1768:
A Renard of Hestia Familia. Like Mikoto, she's a sorceress from the Far East.
She can use rare magic, but she's poor at close combat.
t1769:
An adventurer of Hestia Familia.
With her hair tied up, she wears a sweet, innocent pale-pink swimsuit.
She's delighted to play in the pool with Bell and the rest of the Familia.
t1770:
An adventurer of Hestia Familia.
To cheer on Chigusa's romance, she puts on a dress and heads to the ball with her.
Her Far Eastern allure, adorned by the dress, captivates many... but inside, she's the same hopeless, naughty fox as ever.
t1771: Captain of Loki Familia and a first-tier adventurer. Brilliant not only in combat but also in intellect and command, he's a towering figure who holds the Familia together on every front. He and Riveria and Gareth go way back.
t1772:
An adventurer of Loki Familia.
He wears his best outfit for the Snow Competition.
He takes art seriously—so seriously that he tends to get carried away.
t1773: One of the world's foremost mages. One of Loki Familia's oldest members and its vice-captain. Born of elven royalty, her name resounds not only among her kin but across the world. To the members, she's like a mother.
t1774:
An adventurer of Loki Familia.
She wears a black swimsuit that exudes mature allure.
She feels reluctant and embarrassed about a swimsuit far more revealing than her usual clothes.
t1775:
An adventurer of Loki Familia.
At Finn's suggestion, she wears a calm red outfit.
Watching Finn get carried away, she can only sigh.

t1977:
An adventurer of Hestia Familia.
Chosen by Orion's Arrow at the Moon Festival, he sets out with Artemis on a journey to slay "Antares."
The gear he wears was provided by Hermes for that journey.
t1978:
An adventurer of Loki Familia.
She wears a Far Eastern furisode, a gift from Loki.
Thrilled by the sight of Ais, lovely in a furisode of her own, she dreams of a New Year trip with her idol in such pretty outfits, and so aims for "First Fortune" at the Guild's "New Year's Lucky Girl Pageant."
t1979:
A supporter who cut ties with her past and converted to Hestia Familia.
Her sharp mind and judgment save the party from crisis.
She goes on the attack not only in the Dungeon but with Bell too, though without much success.
t1980:
She wears Prum-sized mining clothes custom-ordered by Hermes.
They're easy to move in and comfy, and Bell said they suit her, so she loves them.
"To carve out our Familia's future, that giant gold nugget will be mine!" With that resolve, she came to the mining town of Golden.
